---
title: "kubernetes_env"
description: "Real, generated bindings for `kubernetes_env`."
---

`kubernetes_env` -- real, typed bindings generated directly from the
`hashicorp/kubernetes` provider schema, in every SDK language.

Every tab below is a complete, runnable program, not a fragment,
real enough to save and run exactly as shown.

## Example

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Go">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
    	ubx "github.com/ubiquex/ubx-sdk-go/runtime"
    	env "github.com/ubiquex/ubx-sdk-kubernetes/sdk/go/kubernetes/env"
    )

    func main() {
    	ubx.Main(ubx.Stack("payments", func() {
    		ubx.Intent(ubx.IntentInfo{Summary: "payments own env"})

    		ubx.Resource(env.Env, "ci-runner", env.EnvConfig{
    			ApiVersion:    "example",
    			Kind:          "example",
    			Container:     "example",
    			FieldManager:  "example",
    			Force:         true,
    			InitContainer: "example",
    		})
    	}))
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="TypeScript">
    ```typescript
    import { intent, resource, stack } from "@ubx/sdk";
    import { Env } from "jsr:@ubx/sdk-kubernetes/kubernetes/env/env";

    export default stack("payments", () => {
      intent({ summary: "payments own env" });

      resource(Env, "ci-runner", {
        apiVersion: "example",
        kind: "example",
        container: "example",
        fieldManager: "example",
        force: true,
        initContainer: "example",
      });
    });
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Python">
    ```python
    import ubx_sdk as ubx
    from ubx.kubernetes.env import Env, EnvConfig

    def describe():
        ubx.intent("payments own env")

        ubx.resource(Env, "ci-runner", EnvConfig(
            api_version="example",
            kind="example",
            container="example",
            field_manager="example",
            force=True,
            init_container="example",
        ))

    if __name__ == "__main__":
        ubx.run("payments", describe)
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Markdown">
    ```
    Create kubernetes_env, with api version example, kind example,
    container example, field manager example, force true, init
    container example.
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
